text:
Predicates:
Flies(x, y) ::: x flies to y.
From(x, y) ::: x flies from y.
Departure(x, y) ::: the departure airport of x is y.
Arrival(x, y) ::: the arrival airport of x is y.
Premises:
Flies(susan, lga) ::: Susan flies to LGA airport.
∀x ∀y ∀z (Flies(x, y) → ¬(Departure(x, z) ∧ Arrival(x, z))) ::: The departure and arrival can not be the same airport.
From(john, lga) ::: John flies from LGA airport.
Conclusion:
Flies(susan, lga) ∧ From(susan, lga) ::: Susan flies from LGA airport.
